title: Concept: Stylesheet loaded over plaintext HTTP
description: A stylesheet link that points at plaintext HTTP in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The browser blocks active mixed content but still loads stylesheets in some configurations, and a plaintext stylesheet lets a network attacker restyle the page, including the login form.
applicability: Deployments that render a stylesheet link that points at plaintext HTTP into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The browser blocks active mixed content but still loads stylesheets in some configurations, and a plaintext stylesheet lets a network attacker restyle the page, including the login form.
